items.title: Williams Companies (WMB) Debt Deal Puts Its Valuation Story Back In Focus
items.summary: Why Williams Companies’ New Debt Deal Matters For Shareholders Williams Companies (WMB) has just raised US$2.75b through a multi tranche senior notes offering, with maturities stretching from 2029 out to 2056 and coupons between 5.000% and 6.400%. For anyone following Williams Companies stock, this fresh layer of long dated unsecured debt reshapes the funding mix and provides a clearer view of fixed interest costs. That, in turn, can factor directly into how you assess cash flow resilience...
